checklist.title: Finish setting up
checklist.description: A few quick steps, and BizCost is ready for your business.

profile.title: Complete your business profile
profile.missingBoth: Add your business name in Arabic and your logo.
profile.missingArabicName: Add your business name in Arabic.
profile.done: Your business name in Arabic and your logo are saved.

trn.title: Add your TRN
trn.todo: Your business is registered for VAT. Add its 15-digit Tax Registration Number.

invite.title: Invite your first team member
invite.todo: Send an invitation by email, and choose what they can see and do.
invite.done: Your team has started: someone joined or was invited.

location.title: Add your second branch
location.todo: Add each place you work from, so you can follow each branch on its own.

allSet.title: You're all set
allSet.body: Your business is set up and ready.

costs.title: Let's find the real cost of what you sell
costs.description: Follow these steps, and BizCost works out what each product really costs.
costs.description_services: Follow these steps, and BizCost works out what each service really costs.

products.title: Add what you sell
products.title_projects: Add your services and work items
products.todo: Your products and services, with their prices.

recipes.title: Add what you use to make it
recipes.todo: For each product you make, the materials it uses and how much.
recipes.todo_food: For each product you make, its recipe: the ingredients and supplies, and how much.
recipes.remaining_one: {{count}} product you make doesn't have what goes into it yet.
recipes.remaining_other: {{count}} products you make don't have what goes into them yet.
recipes.remainingFood_one: {{count}} product you make has no recipe yet.
recipes.remainingFood_other: {{count}} products you make have no recipe yet.
recipes.done: Every product you make has what goes into it.
recipes.done_food: Every product you make has its recipe.

purchases.title: Add purchase prices
purchases.todo: Enter what you buy, so each material has its price.
purchases.todo_food: Enter what you buy, so each ingredient and supply has its price.
purchases.remaining_one: {{count}} material you use has no price yet: enter a purchase of it.
purchases.remaining_other: {{count}} materials you use have no price yet: enter a purchase of them.
purchases.remainingFood_one: {{count}} ingredient or supply you use has no price yet: enter a purchase of it.
purchases.remainingFood_other: {{count}} ingredients and supplies you use have no price yet: enter a purchase of them.
purchases.done: Everything you use has a price.

running_costs.title: Add your running costs
running_costs.runningCosts: Rent, electricity, salaries and other regular costs, so each product carries its share.
running_costs.runningCosts_services: Rent, electricity, salaries and other regular costs, so each service carries its share.

owner_time.title: Add your time
owner_time.both: What an hour of your time is worth, and the minutes each product takes you.
owner_time.both_services: What an hour of your time is worth, and the minutes each service takes you.
owner_time.hourlyRate: What an hour of your time is worth.
owner_time.minutes: The minutes each product takes you.
owner_time.minutes_services: The minutes each service takes you.
owner_time.done: Your time is part of your costs.

product_costs.title: See your product costs
product_costs.todo: Once what you sell and what it costs are in, see what each product really costs.
product_costs.todo_services: Once what you sell and what it costs are in, see what each service really costs.
product_costs.remaining_one: {{count}} product still has part of its cost missing.
product_costs.remaining_other: {{count}} products still have part of their cost missing.
product_costs.remainingServices_one: {{count}} service still has part of its cost missing.
product_costs.remainingServices_other: {{count}} services still have part of their cost missing.
product_costs.done: Your product costs are complete before running costs, which are added once you record your sales.
product_costs.done_services: Your service costs are complete before running costs, which are added once you record your sales.

sales.title: Add or import your sales
sales.todo: Enter today's sales or one sale, so your real profit can be worked out.

real_profit.title: See your real profit
real_profit.todo: Once a finalized sale has its whole cost, see what you really earn.

ready.title: Your product costs are in, before running costs
ready.title_services: Your service costs are in, before running costs
ready.body: Each product's cost comes from your purchases and your time; its share of running costs is added once you record your sales. It stays up to date as you enter new purchases.
ready.bodyWithoutTime: Each product's cost comes from your purchases; its share of running costs is added once you record your sales. It stays up to date as you enter new purchases.
ready.bodyServices: Each service's cost comes from your time and what it uses; its share of running costs is added once you record your sales.
ready.bodyServicesWithoutTime: Each service's cost comes from what it uses; its share of running costs is added once you record your sales.

costs.titleProfit: Let's calculate your first real profit
costs.descriptionProfit: Follow these steps, and BizCost works out what you really earn.

profitReady.title: Your real profit is ready
profitReady.body: It comes from your sales, what they cost you, your running costs and your time. It stays up to date as you enter sales, purchases and expenses.
profitReady.bodyWithoutTime: It comes from your sales, what they cost you and your running costs. It stays up to date as you enter sales, purchases and expenses.

profit.title: Real profit
profit.costsSince: Running costs since your first sale on {{day}}: {{amount}}
profit.costsAhead: Your running costs so far are more than this month's sales.

moneyWent.title: Where your money went
moneyWent.hint: Out of your sales this month so far.

chart.title: Sales and real profit by day
chart.summary: Sales and real profit for each day from {{from}} to {{to}}. The table below has every day.
chart.summarySales: Sales for each day from {{from}} to {{to}}. The table below has every day.
chart.hint: Each day carries its share of running costs at your rate.
chart.hintBefore: The days are before running costs until {{day}}, once you have 7 days of sales.
chart.hintMonth: Your real profit above takes off the month's running costs so far.

top.title: Top sellers
top.marginHint: Real margin, among those whose costs are complete.

concerns.title: Sold at a loss or a low margin
concerns.hint: A real margin under 10% this month.

costIncreases.title: Cost increases
costIncreases.hint: Materials in what you sold whose average cost rose 10% or more in 30 days.

needsLook.title: Needs a look
needsLook.unpricedMaterialsHint: Materials behind your sales that were never bought: enter a purchase so their cost counts.
needsLook.channelsWithoutFeesHint: Channels that keep part of each sale, with nothing entered for it: add what they keep.
needsLook.productsWithoutRecipeHint: Their materials can't be counted: add what goes into them.
needsLook.materialsInNoRecipeHint: They count with your running costs. Add them to a recipe to make them that item's own cost.
